recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel cassette J-card layout featuring a high-contrast radial sunburst of orange and yellow light beams against a black background. The central panel is bisected by a horizontal 'torn paper' window revealing a deep purple textured void, while the spine and back flap utilize solid orange and white blocks for information hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of light beams converging at the vertical center
Rough, organic torn edges contrasting with geometric light rays
Vibrant orange spine acting as a visual anchor for vertical text
Layered depth created by the purple 'inner' reveal behind the sunburst
coreInvariants: Horizontal torn-paper reveal in the center of the main panel
Solid orange spine with black vertical text
White back panel with right-aligned black sans-serif text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary graphic occupies the right two-thirds, with a central horizontal focal point inside the torn window.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid orange spine strip provides a vertical structural anchor between the busy graphic and the white text panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the radial beams to the center, then move left across the spine to the tracklist on the white panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black areas between light beams and the white background of the back flap provide essential breathing room for legibility.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum against absolute black for maximum 'glow' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Main display text features extended horizontal bars that connect or pierce through adjacent letters
Heavy weight with sharp, angular terminals
Body text is a clean, mid-weight grotesque sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' and 'E' in the display title have elongated horizontal strokes forming a continuous line through the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact custom display lettering paired with functional, neutral Swiss-style sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set nature of the display text skeleton.
Standard for the clean, functional body text on the back panel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cassette J-card layout. The main panel features a black background with a radial sunburst of orange and yellow light rays emanating from the top and bottom center. In the middle, a horizontal 'torn paper' gap reveals a textured dark purple background. The spine is solid orange. The back flap is solid white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, extended geometric sans-serif title in the purple torn window with an orange-to-yellow gradient fill and black outline. Add right-aligned black sans-serif tracklist text to the white panel and vertical black text to the orange spine.

verificationChecks: Sunburst rays converge at the vertical center line
Torn edges look organic and fibrous
High contrast between orange beams and black background

adjustableVariables: Width of the torn paper window

avoid: Messy or overlapping text on the white panel

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torn edges have a white 'paper core' highlight
Check that the radial beams do not overlap the spine
Verify the display text has the characteristic horizontal bar extensions
Confirm the back panel text is flush-right
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Radial Sunburst Background] + [Horizontal Torn Paper Reveal] + [Solid Color Spine] + [Geometric Extended Display Type] to create a classic 80s rock aesthetic.
